'''Ota''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who worked to stop [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] from acquiring weapons from the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Piddock]] under the orders of his rival Duke [[Dimmock]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ota was designed by [[Dave Allen]] and [[Daniel Lovat Clark]] for ''[[The Long Arm of the Hutt]]'', a supplement ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2012]].
